title: UCP capability namespace tree
caption: Names follow reverse domain, service, capability. Everything under dev.ucp belongs to the UCP governing body and carries the release date as its version; vendors use their own reverse domain and version independently. Payment extensions moved from shopping to common.payment in v2026-08-25. Items marked draft exist only on main.
alt: Tree. dev.ucp has three services: shopping, common and lodging. Shopping has checkout, cart, catalog.search, catalog.lookup, order and permalink; checkout is extended by fulfillment, discount and buyer_consent. Common has identity_linking, location.search and location.lookup, loyalty as an extension, payment and the draft ask capability. Payment has ap2_mandate (formerly shopping.ap2_mandate), authentication for 3DS2 actions, split_payments and terms. Lodging has a draft booking capability. Separately, com.vendor and org.org namespaces version independently.
